about: Sixty opening statements written by a separate AI agent that was told not to read any file and never saw Mukoti's rules or prompts. Used once, on 2026-11-25, as a held-out check. Not written or reviewed by a clinician or a native speaker; the author marked the items it was unsure of. Once the rules are changed because of these sentences, this set is no longer held out.

rows.text: Ndine chipfuva chandibata kubva svondo rapfuura, ndiri kukosora zvine makararwa machena. Ndiri kufema zvakanaka, kungoti chikosoro chiri kundinetsa usiku.

rows.sign: child under five cannot drink or breastfeed or vomits everything
rows.text: Mwana ane mwedzi misere, kubva nezuro ari kuramba zamu zvachose. Ukamuisa pazamu anongotendeuka, kana mvura haasi kuda, uye haachina simba rekuchema.

rows.sign: fainted earlier but awake and talking now
rows.text: Ndambodonha ndiri mumutsetse kubhanga, ndanzwa dzungu ndokubva ndangoona vanhu vava kundimutsa. Ndava kunzwa zviri nani, kungoti ndakati rukutu.
Morning sister, I've just come for my blood pressure tablets, they finished on Friday. I'm feeling fine, no headaches, nothing.
Sisi ndibatsireiwo, mwana ari kugwinha! Atanga tiri mukombi, muviri wese waoma, maziso atendeuka kwasara machena chete.
I'm about five months pregnant and I started spotting this morning, just a little on the pad. I don't have pain but my mother said I must come straight away.
Sisi, musana uri kundiuraya, ndave nevhiki ndichitadza kukotama. Ndinorima mumunda zuva rese, zvimwe ndizvo zvakonzera.

rows.sign: burn, broken bone or other injury
rows.text: Ndadonha nebhasikoro ndichienda kubasa, zvino ruoko urwu handichagoni kurusimudza. Rwazvimba uye pano apa rwaita sekunge rwakombama.
Kubva pandakarasikirwa nebasa handisi kurara, pfungwa dzinongoti zviri nani ndisisipo. Nezuro ndakatotenga tambo, asi ndakazotya.
Ndauya kuzonyoresa nhumbu, ndine mwedzi mina. Hapana chiri kundinetsa, hapana ropa, hapana kurwadziwa, mwana ari kutamba zvakanaka mudumbu.
It's my mum, she has asthma but the pump is not helping today. She can't even finish a sentence, she's gasping and leaning forward like this, please help us.
Mabvi angu ari kurwadza mwanangu, kunyanya kana kuchitonhora mangwanani. Ndachembera, ndipewo zvekuzora kana mapiritsi.
Mwana wangu adya mushonga wemakonzo wataisa kuseri kwewadhiropu, tawana pakiti yacho yakavhurika. Ane makore mana, handizivi kuti adya wakawanda sei.

rows.sign: blood in stool, urine, vomit or cough without heavy bleeding
rows.text: Ndava nemasvondo matatu ndichikosora, zvino mazuva ano ndikakosora panobuda tumaropa. Usiku ndinodikitira zvekuti magumbeze anonyorova, uye ndaonda.
My son had a nosebleed yesterday at school but it stopped on its own after a few minutes. He's fine today, I just wanted to ask if it's something to worry about.

rows.sign: cannot be woken or barely responsive
rows.text: Sisi, ndauya nambuya vangu, kubva mangwanani havasi kumuka. Tavadaidza, tavazunza, vanongogomera chete vasingavhuri maziso.
rule_signs: Cannot be woken, or very drowsy

rows.text: Ndauya kuzotora mapiritsi epfari emwana, ave kuda kupera. Kubva paakatanga kuanwa gore rapfuura haasati ambogwinha zvakare, ari kuenda kuchikoro zvakanaka.

rows.sign: heavy bleeding that will not stop
rows.text: My uncle's nose has been bleeding since four in the morning and it's not stopping, we've soaked a whole towel. He takes those tablets for thinning the blood and now he says he's feeling weak.

rows.sign: young baby unwell without emergency signs
rows.text: Mwana uyu ane mazuva mapfumbamwe chete, ari kupisa muviri kubva usiku. Ari kuyamwa zvake asi ari kungochema-chema, haasi kurara.
rule_signs: Baby only days or weeks old

rows.text: Ini nemukomana wangu tauya kuzoongororwa ropa, tinoda kuziva status yedu tisati taroorana. Hapana ari kurwara.
Ndakarega kuenda kumwedzi kwava nemwedzi mitatu, uye test yandakaita yakaratidza kuti ndine pamuviri. Zvino kubva nezuro manheru ndava kuona ropa, nechiuno chiri kurwadza.
I've come to have my dressing changed, the cut on my leg from last week. It's healing nicely, no bleeding, no pus.
Mukoma wangu ari kutadza kufema, ari kufemera pamusoro kunge munhu ari kudzipwa. Haachagoni kupedza sentence imwe chete, uye ziya riri kungoerera.
Ndiri pamaARV asi handisi kunwa mushonga kwava nemwedzi miviri, ndanga ndiri kumusha mapiritsi akapera. Ndiri kunzwa zvakanaka hangu, ndinoda kutanga patsva.

rows.sign: fainted earlier but awake and talking now
rows.text: My son passed out at school during assembly, the teacher phoned me. He woke up after a minute and he's talking normally now, just a bit of a headache.

rows.sign: child under five cannot drink or breastfeed or vomits everything
rows.text: My daughter is three, since last night she's vomiting everything, even a sip of water comes straight back up. Nothing is staying down and now she's just lying there.
rule_signs: Child cannot drink or vomits everything

rows.text: Ndinorwadziwa nemudumbu pese pandinoenda kumwedzi. Ropa racho rinouya zvakajairika, mazuva mana richipera, ndinongoda mapiritsi ekurwadziwa.
Ini ndaneta neupenyu huno, sisi. Mazuva ano ndinongogara ndichifunga kuti dai ndangozviuraya zvipere.

rows.sign: burn, broken bone or other injury
rows.text: Mwana azvipisa nemvura inopisa yanga iri pachitofu, yamudirikira paruoko. Paita mabundu ane mvura uye ganda riri kusvuuka, ari kuchema nekurwadziwa.
Hi, I'd like to have a blood test for sugar, my employer wants the results for the medical. I'm not sick or anything.
Muzukuru uyu awira pasi kaviri husiku hwapfuura, muviri wese uchidedera, furo richibuda mumuromo. Handizivi kana iri tsviyo, haasati ambozviita, uye kubva ipapo haasi kunyatsotaura.
Ziso rangu rekuruboshwe riri kuvava nekubuda misodzi kubva nezuro, rakati piriviri. Ndinofunga iguruva rekubasa, ndinoshanda kuchigayo.
Sister, the baby drank paraffin, it was in a Mazoe bottle and she thought it was juice. She's coughing a lot and you can smell it on her breath.
Mwana ane dzihwa nekukosora zvishoma kubva nezuro. Ari kunwa zvakanaka, ari kuyamwa, uye ari kutamba zvake, asi ndati regai ndimuunze aonekwe.

rows.sign: heavy bleeding that will not stop
rows.text: Mukomana uyu achekwa negirazi paruoko tichiri kumba. Tasunga nejira asi ropa riri kungoerera, jira rese ratonyorova, uye ava kuti ari kunzwa dzungu.

rows.sign: blood in stool, urine, vomit or cough without heavy bleeding
rows.text: Since yesterday when I pass urine there's blood in it, it's reddish, and it burns. Otherwise I'm okay, I even went to work this morning.
This toothache is killing me, I didn't sleep at all last night. Can I see someone for the tooth or at least get something for the pain?

rows.sign: cannot be woken or barely responsive
rows.text: Mwana wangu akangorembera mumaoko kubva pakati pehusiku, haachadaviri kana ndikamudaidza. Maziso akangoti tuzu akatarisa kumusoro, kana kuchema haachachemi.
Ndauya kuzobaiwa jekiseni rekuronga mhuri, reDepo, date rangu rasvika nhasi. Handina dambudziko, ndinongoda kubaiwa ndichienda kubasa.
Mukadzi wangu ane nhumbu yemwedzi misere. Angoerekana ava kubuda ropa tichiri kumba, nyangwe risiri rakawanda, saka ndamumhanyisa kuno.

rows.sign: young baby unwell without emergency signs
rows.text: My baby is three weeks old and her eyes and skin have been looking yellow for about two days. She's feeding fine and she wakes up for her feeds, but my mother-in-law said I should bring her.
rule_signs: Baby only days or weeks old

rows.text: Ndine asima, ndauya kuzotora pombi itsva nekuti yangu yapera. Mazuva ano ndiri kufema zvakanaka, chipfuva hachisi kumbondibata.
My husband had a fit at home about twenty minutes ago and now he's had another one in the car park. He bit his tongue and he's still shaking, he doesn't know where he is.
Ndauya nemwana kuzobaiwa majekiseni emavhiki matanhatu nekuyerwa uremu. Hapana chiri kumunetsa, ari kuyamwa zvakanaka uye ari kukura.

rows.sign: child under five cannot drink or breastfeed or vomits everything
rows.text: Mwana uyu ane makore maviri, zvese zvaanodya kana kunwa ari kurutsa. Kunyange mvura yeshuga nemunyu yandamupa yadzoka yese, hapana chiri kugara mudumbu.
Ndauya kuzotora mapiritsi angu eBP, apera nezuro. Hapana chimwe chiri kundinetsa, kungoti mundiyerewo blood pressure yacho ndisati ndaenda.
I don't know how to say this, but I've been thinking of ending it all. I kept my mother's tablets aside and last night I nearly took all of them.

rows.sign: fainted earlier but awake and talking now
rows.text: Mai vangu vambofenda vari kuchechi mangwanani ano, vakaita seminiti vasingazivi zviri kuitika. Vamuka zvavo, iye zvino vari kutaura zvakanaka, asi tati ngavaonekwe.
Ndauya kuzobviswa POP paruoko rwandakatyoka mwedzi wapfuura, ndiro date randakapihwa. Hapachisina kurwadza, minwe iri kufamba zvakanaka.
Baba ava varumwa nenyoka mumunda mangwanani ano, pagumbo apa. Gumbo riri kuzvimba richikwira, uye vava kurutsa vachiti vari kuona rima.
I'm here for my review, I'm on the tablets for fits. I haven't had a fit in over two years, I just need the repeat.

rows.sign: heavy bleeding that will not stop
rows.text: Muroora wedu akasununguka kumba nezuro husiku, asi ropa riri kungobuda zvakawandisa, machira ese azara. Ava kungoti ari kunzwa kutonhora uye haachina simba rekumira.

rows.sign: burn, broken bone or other injury
rows.text: I fell off the ladder at work and my ankle is swollen like this, I can't put weight on it. I think maybe it's broken.
Ndakarutsa kamwe chete nezuro mushure mekudya nyama yandakatenga pamusika. Nhasi ndiri kudya nekunwa zvakanaka, ndangoda mushonga wemudumbu nekuti muchiri kuruma zvishoma.
Mwana uyu kufema kwake kwandityisa, ari kukweva mweya nesimba mbabvu dzichipinda mukati. Miromo yake yatosvipa uye pachipfuva pari kurira muridzo.

rows.sign: blood in stool, urine, vomit or cough without heavy bleeding
rows.text: Ndine manyoka kubva nezuro, asi nhasi ndaona paine ropa pandaenda kuchimbuzi. Mudumbu muri kuruma zvakanyanya, asi ndiri kugona kunwa mvura.
I have this rash on my arms that's been itching for two weeks now, it gets worse at night. I tried aqueous cream but it's not helping.

rows.sign: cannot be woken or barely responsive
rows.text: Sister please, it's my father, he just went quiet in the car on the way here and now he's not answering us. He's breathing, but even when we shake him there's nothing.
I brought her for the nine months injection, the measles one, and for weighing. She's eating well, drinking well, very playful.

rows.sign: young baby unwell without emergency signs
rows.text: Kacheche aka kane vhiki mbiri, paguvhu pako pari kubuda urwa uye pari kunhuwa. Kari kuyamwa zvakanaka, asi ambuya vati kaendeswe kukiriniki.

rules_alone_after_fixes.note: After the rules were changed using this set. No longer a held-out result.

note: 'rules_alone' and 'pipeline' are the one clean run, made before any rule was changed because of this set. An earlier attempt the same hour was thrown away: the gateway returned 504 or 502 for many of the notes, so those visits fell back to 'urgent'. The helper's fallback was then changed to retry the note without reasoning.
